messages.subject: dredge pcountopen
parts:
Hi,

I am using pcountOpen to estimate abundance of sage grouse. I have 11 variables for lambda and that's why I wanted to use dredge to assess all possible combination of these variables. But each time I am getting following error message

"Error in umf_get_specs(x) : unknown "unmarkedFitPCO" model structure"

My code is:
Full<-pcountOpen(lambdaformula = ~pland_4_500+lsi_4_500+enn_4_500+lsi_2_500+np_3_500+enn_3_500+pland_3_800+pland_2_800+np_5_800+enn_5_800, gammaformula = ~1, omegaformula = ~1, pformula = ~1, estabun_open_800,K=250, dynamics = "trend",mixture = "NB") 
d1<-dredge(Full, rank="AICc)

I tried using pdredge, but I am getting the same error message.

Can anyone please help me this. I will be really grateful.

Thanks,
Leo
